about: Accepted differences between Power BI Desktop's TMDL and DashCraft's after the same edits (ADR-0014). Each entry replaces the `desktop` lines of a session's Desktop-saved file with the `dashcraft` lines before the byte comparison of crates/pbi-ops/tests/save.rs (edits_save_like_power_bi_desktop). New identifiers read `<new id>`. An entry that no longer applies fails the test: delete it. An entry is approved by the review of the pull request that adds it. At most 20 entries; the list only shrinks, except for reviewed changes of a new Desktop version.

desktop: column 'GT4 Margin' = Orders[Line Amount] - Orders[Line Cost]
dashcraft: column 'GT4 Margin' = Orders[Line Amount] - Orders[Line Cost]
deviations.reason: Desktop leaves out the data type it infers for a calculated column; DashCraft writes it with isDataTypeInferred so a reopened project has the column's type before a refresh.
The same for the inferred type of a calculated table's column.
